**7 SAME, 0 REVIEW.** REVIEW rows have a different molecular formula (prodrug, ester, mixture component): the LINCS expression belongs to a related compound, not the exact structure given to the GNN. Keep them only with that substitution declared in the methods, or drop them.

## Related forms carrying different labels (cohort compounds only)

Same drug stem, different DICTrank labels. The 'any toxic form -> 1' rule only merges forms with the SAME InChIKey block; forms with different blocks (e.g. a prodrug) are separate rows, so the cohort label for the kept form may disagree with its sibling.
